headline: Pangenome variant calling, VCF simulation, and viral quasispecies comparison tools
label: Genomic Variant Calling Tools
summary: Pangenome references and long-read data are pushing variant calling and benchmarking tools beyond linear-reference workflows.
synthesis: The items share a focus on computational tooling for variant-level genomic analysis, each paired with explicit benchmarking. PanVariants is a pangenome-based calling pipeline that combines k-mer and mapping methods and reports reduced SNV errors and improved structural-variant F1 relative to linear-reference and existing approaches. vcfsim is an open-source CLI wrapping msprime to generate all-sites VCFs with variable ploidy and missing-data patterns for benchmarking and population analyses. QoALa is an R workflow (longreadvqs) for comparing viral quasispecies from long-read sequencing, with noise minimization and benchmarking on simulated SARS-CoV-2 data. What is new is the combination of pangenome-based calling, controlled missing-data simulation, and long-read quasispecies comparison within a shared benchmarking framing.
